latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the database-operations skill.

- Provides comprehensive guidance for schema design, migrations, and query optimization, with a focus on PostgreSQL and EF Core.
- Includes best practices for indexing, N+1 problem detection, full-text search, table partitioning, and caching.
- Offers ready-to-use SQL patterns for user management, audit trails, soft deletes, and safe migrations.
- Built to answer implementation-level database performance and design questions.
